    compute_descriptives.Rd

    uses psych

    compute_descriptives(df, dv, iv = NULL, file = NULL)

    Arguments

    df

    dataframe

    dv

    index of dependent variables

    iv

    index of independent variables

    file

    output filename

    Details

    returns xlsx
